SEC Rule 83: Risk Disclosure Requirements for Annual Reports

Regulator: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)
Jurisdiction: United States
Publication Date: 2005-06-15
Effective Date: 2005-09-01
Source URL: https://www.sec.gov/rules/final/33-8618.htm
License: Public Domain

All issuers must disclose material risks in their annual reports. Failure to do so results in immediate audit requirements and potential enforcement action under Section 13(a) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
